subject.title: fix(codex): bound app-server websocket handshake waits to requestTimeoutMs

question: Should `appServer.requestTimeoutMs` become the WebSocket and Unix upgrade ceiling, including for existing installations that configured a short request timeout?
rationale: This fixes an indefinite hang without adding configuration, but it intentionally expands an existing setting’s semantics and can reject slow yet legitimate connection upgrades.

options.title: Reuse request timeout
options.body: Approve the current shared-budget design so connection establishment and subsequent control-plane calls have one operator-controlled deadline.

options.title: Use a fixed handshake ceiling
options.body: Keep handshake timing independent of short operator request budgets by applying a fixed internal connection ceiling.

options.title: Add a separate setting
options.body: Introduce a dedicated handshake timeout, accepting another configuration surface and its upgrade/documentation burden.

recommendation.title: Reuse request timeout
recommendation.body: Approve the current shared-budget design so connection establishment and subsequent control-plane calls have one operator-controlled deadline.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature-history trail points most strongly to the person who introduced the Codex extension and app-server ownership boundary.
